resources.string:
Drafts and your site key stay in this app’s private, backup-excluded storage. Uninstalling or clearing app data deletes these local copies. Keep your original site-key backup.

Preparing a post sends its screenshot, title and caption to the Croptop publishing service. Your private site key is not sent. The service retains operation journals, including site identity, text, media hashes, status and receipts, indefinitely. Private media and staging are eligible for cleanup after seven days only after reconciliation succeeds; uncertain operations retain their media.

Published content is public. Copies on IPFS or other services may persist. Removing this phone’s connection prevents new local signing after removal completes, but does not revoke other key copies or cancel already-authorized requests.

This pilot does not include a hosted operator privacy policy. Public distribution remains gated on that policy and the store privacy declarations.
